scenes.heading: Handling confidential information and access responsibly

sents.d: Handling confidential information and access responsibly
Trust around sensitive access is central to this type of work.

VA work often involves access to sensitive information — email accounts, financial details, passwords, private business plans — and handling this responsibly is central to maintaining client trust and your own professional reputation.
Using a password manager to share credentials securely, rather than sending them over email or chat, and requesting revoked access promptly when an engagement ends, are basic but important practices.
Being explicit with clients about what you will and won't do with access (e.g. not reading personal emails unrelated to assigned tasks) builds trust and protects you from ambiguity about boundaries.

take: Share access securely and be explicit about boundaries.
